_about: The operator-bundle entry of the ethereum-eth route (bETH), kept OUT of ops/routes.json while the route is held: ops/bundle.py then knows no such route and builds nothing for it (as for Base and BNB Smart Chain). tools/native-ether/test_bundle_native_ether.py adds this entry to the manifest in memory and checks that every role assembles, renders and lints. When the route is lifted, the integrator copies `entry` into ops/routes.json under `routes` as `ethereum-eth`, adds `facts` to its `facts.values`, and sets source_rev to the reviewed commit. GENERATED by tools/native-ether/route_files.py.
